message.subject: IE3 4 kW motor – framework renewal proposal
message.body:
Thank you for your quotation. We can offer a 24-month framework at 8,490 units per year in exchange for a competitive delivered price.

Please confirm either EUR 209.06 per unit, payment 60 days, contract 24 months, DAP; or EUR 207.68 per unit, payment 30 days, contract 24 months, DAP.

The competing quote quote:7100042 is EUR 245.59 per unit DAP, so your current EXW offer needs improvement to make renewal attractive. Your scorecard sc:70520@2026Q3 records 81.1% on-time delivery; we need stronger delivery performance alongside the renewed framework.

The second package offers faster payment in return for the lower price. Please return your best achievable package.

batch.note: Anchor a meaningful reduction and trade longer commitment and faster payment for delivered pricing.

trace.final_text: Sent two renewal options, trading a 24-month commitment and faster payment for lower delivered prices.

message.subject: Re: Motor framework – revised packages
message.body:
Thank you for reducing the price. The remaining EXW and 14-day terms still leave the renewal uncompetitive.

In return for delivered terms and a 24-month contract, we can increase our proposal to EUR 212.01 per unit, payment 60 days, contract 24 months, DAP. Alternatively, we can retain your 14-day payment terms at EUR 209.86 per unit, contract 24 months, DAP.

Please confirm one of these packages or provide your closest complete counterproposal, including payment, duration and Incoterm.

batch.note: Supplier moved price only; modest reciprocal move, with fast-payment alternative and explicit request for full terms.

trace.final_text: Sent revised delivered-price options, including an alternative retaining 14-day payment.

message.subject: Re: Framework renewal – narrowing the gap
message.body:
Thank you for the further price reduction. We can make a smaller additional move to EUR 213.19 per unit, payment 60 days, contract 24 months, DAP; alternatively EUR 211.03 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, DAP.

The two-year duration and delivered terms are central to our proposal. Please include these in your next counteroffer rather than reverting to the one-year EXW conditions.

batch.note: Smaller reciprocal concession; supplier remains on standard terms.

trace.final_text: Sent a smaller price concession and requested a complete two-year, DAP counteroffer.

message.subject: Re: Renewal – payment and freight options
message.body:
Thank you for your continued movement. We are willing to keep payment at 14 days and can handle collection if that unlocks a stronger price.

Our alternatives are EUR 211.03 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, DAP; or EUR 204.57 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, EXW.

Please provide your best renewal offer. A full two-year agreement would give both parties greater planning certainty.

batch.note: Hold target and offer supplier-standard freight/payment structure with longer commitment.

trace.final_text: Held our target and added an EXW option with 14-day payment.

message.subject: Re: Motor renewal – outstanding commercial terms
message.body:
Thank you for your latest reduction. Please make one further improvement so we can bring this renewal to a conclusion.

Our proposal remains EUR 211.03 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, DAP; or EUR 204.57 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, EXW. If longer payment suits your pricing better, we can instead offer EUR 213.19 per unit, payment 60 days, contract 24 months, DAP.

Please confirm your best achievable price and whether you can extend the quoted duration to 24 months.

batch.note: Keep cost target unchanged while supplier continues moving; request another reduction and duration confirmation.

trace.final_text: Requested another improvement while holding our proposed packages unchanged.
Accepted the final offer: €215.60 per unit, 14-day payment, 12 months, EXW; total horizon cost €4,137,142.29.
